text: When the Quality Reporter readiness gate fails on 'Extract Log' but .aee/extract-log.jsonl is fully populated on disk, the fix is to re-register the artifact with 'aee-artifact add Extract Log .aee/extract-log.jsonl' — the Fact Extractor completed work but its registration was lost (e.g. after a force-push clearing artifacts.jsonl).

When gh-as-agent push fails with 'terminal prompts disabled' (HTTPS remote without SSH), push directly with the token: git push https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/<org>/<repo>.git <branch>:<branch> — this is the standard fallback for all agents in this environment.
